name: Product Jobs
shortdescription: Job board with a focus on roles in Product in the US and remote, that I built using Claude Code and deployed using Vercel and Railway.
technologies: Claude Code, React, node.js, Vercel, Railway

name: Job Agent Search Bot
shortdescription: An autonomous job search agent built on Claude Code. A guided setup interview builds your candidate profile, then it runs daily — pulling live postings directly from company ATS APIs and the web, scoring each against your background, and logging the best matches to a Notion database. Fully unattended after setup, triggered on wake with no fixed schedule to babysit.
technologies: Claude Code CLI, Bash, launchd, Notion (via MCP)

name: Clara - Personal Messaging Agent
shortdescription: An SMS assistant built using Claude Code. A guided /setup connects you own Twilio, Google Calendar, and Notion accounts, then it runs daily - texting a morning briefing, an afternoon to-do check, and a tomorrow preview pulled live from your calendar and Notion. Reply anytime to mark items done or add new ones. Read-only on calendar, add-only on tod-dos, by design.
technologies: Claude API, Notion API, Google Calendar API, Twilio, Railway, Postgres
